features.description: Build a single-file Three.js isometric office scene under experiments/office-3d-poc/ to prove the Coder Horizon workflow runs on deepseek-flash: read a reference image in-harness, generate one HTML file, then verify with a headless-Chromium screenshot and a console-error check instead of trusting the output.

It exits non-zero on any console error or a missing window.__poc, so a clean log cannot pass for a working scene. `--eval` mode added after pixels proved ambiguous: it queried the live scene and showed the 20 slat instances present, visible and coloured #b6804e — which located the real defect, a zero-scale InstancedMesh (Matrix4.compose with the default Vector3() scale erases every instance silently, taking the fence pickets, pillars, roof posts, bamboo blinds, balcony flowers and scooters with it). Three render-and-look rounds: first pass had the ground floor reading as a black void, the roof railing as a black picture frame and neighbour blocks filling the frame; corrections were mullion pitch 1.07 m → 2.33 m, parapet rails dark/thick → light/thin, camera standoff 25–47 m → 44–82 m, neighbours 19 m → 33 m, an interior fill light, 0.09 m blinds → 0.2 m. README records five transferable findings, including that the source post's "single file" rule is unnecessary (a relative classic <script src> also runs from file:// offline) and that r128 is the wrong pin. Screenshots are gitignored; regenerate with `node verify.mjs`.

features.name: Route Devin SWE-2 through omp's auth-gateway
features.description: SWE-2 has no public API (Connect-RPC inside Devin only), and TokenRouter's free GLM lane is exhausted. omp already has a devin provider plus an auth-gateway that re-exposes it as OpenAI Chat Completions on loopback, so add an omp-gateway route (devin/swe-2, efforts medium/high/max) to settings.yaml and scripts/omp-gateway.sh to bring the broker + gateway up in the order the gateway's boot-time catalog requires. No proxy, no plugin.
features.evidence: settings.yaml omp-gateway route + scripts/omp-gateway.sh + docs/models.md + knowledge/systems/omp-gateway-route.md (2026-09-15). Measured at the gateway (the wire dsh uses): devin/swe-2 plain -> `GW OK` in 7.4 s with usage; stream+tools -> streamed tool_calls deltas with server ids; system role + reasoning_effort medium/high/max -> answered with reasoning_content; no bearer -> {"error":"unauthorized"}. Two traps found and written down: a gateway started before the Devin key is on the broker answers `Unknown model: devin/swe-2` until restarted (catalog is boot-time), and max_tokens:20 is eaten by reasoning (finish_reason length, content null). Script: stop -> start (broker, migrate --include-env uploads `[env] devin (api key)`, gateway) -> status `swe-2 via gateway: OK`; second start is idempotent (2 processes). bash -n clean; ./init.sh exit 0 with 14 features / 0 in-progress. Then ./install.sh reinstalled dsh 0.1.5-rc.1 on this machine (it was absent), keys seeded into ~/.dsh/.env (OpenCode Go from the broker snapshot, OMP_GATEWAY_API_KEY from `omp auth-gateway token`), doctor.sh READY (6 ok), dsh web booted clean (roster served 4 client bundles, 0 boot errors), and the user confirmed a composer session on SWE-2 (Devin, via omp) works.

features.name: Make settings-symlink drift impossible to miss
features.description: feat-010 restored the settings.yaml symlink, but it kept drifting: dsh persists settings with writeFile + rename, and rename() replaces a symlink rather than following it, so every explicit settings write (a model pick, a font size, acknowledging the welcome notice) leaves a regular file where the link was — after which repo edits never reach the server and every check still passed. doctor.sh accepted '-L || -f' and recorded only 'present', so four recurrences stayed green, one of them hiding the whole omp-gateway route for a day. Require the link, report how bad the drift already is, and remove the most frequent trigger.
features.evidence: scripts/doctor.sh + settings.yaml (2026-09-16). Cause confirmed in source (dsh-settings-file -> dsh-atomic-write: writeFile('<path>.<hex>.tmp') + rename(temp, path), no realpath) and then reproduced: with the link restored, picking a model in the web picker drifted it inside 3s, the live file then showing the predicted [ text, image ] reserialisation, a rewritten agent-default-model and a new ui-onboarding key. doctor.sh's 'settings' check now requires a symlink resolved into this repo and distinguishes severity; all four branches verified: regular file + diverged -> NOT READY ('the live file has also DIVERGED from the repo, so the server is running settings this repo does not describe'); regular file + content matching -> NOT READY ('content still matches the repo ... the next repo edit is what will not apply'); symlink to /tmp -> NOT READY naming the target; correct symlink -> READY (6 ok). The most frequent trigger is cured rather than documented: the repo settings.yaml now carries ui-onboarding.welcomeNoticeVersion = 2026-08-13.1 (field name from WELCOME_NOTICE_ACK_FIELD in dsh-client-ui-settings-models), so state.acknowledged is true on load and the modal returns null before rendering — no Continue button, no write; verified the notice is gone on a fresh UI load and the link survives it. Trigger corrected after review: it is an explicit settings WRITE, not 'using the UI' — opening the panel, switching workspace and starting a session only read settings and leave the link intact (measured). init.sh exit 0; doctor.sh READY; 163 links / 0 broken; shellcheck clean.
